text:
Happy Halloween! The clouds have been stubborn this afternoon, so sunset around 5:43 will be a gray one with no big color show. For trick-or-treating, plan on low 40s and a light breeze. Bring a jacket and maybe a hat, but you won't need an umbrella.

Skies should thin out after dark, and we cool off to around 33 by morning. The forecasters think the cold start could end up a touch milder than some guidance says, but I'd still expect a little frost on the windshield.

Turn your clocks back an hour before bed. Sunday looks like the nicer half of the weekend: sunny, a light south breeze, and a high near 57, a solid 10 degrees warmer than today. The models all agree, so I'm confident. The mild stretch continues Monday and Tuesday, with highs from the upper 50s to low 60s. Sunday afternoon is the one to get outside for.

week.blurb: Mostly cloudy and chilly this Halloween afternoon, a high near 47, then down to about 33 tonight, so bundle up the trick-or-treaters.
Sunny and milder Sunday, a high near 57 and dry all day, a good one to get outside.
Partly sunny and mild Monday, a high near 62 and dry, a touch warmer than Sunday.
Looks like clouds build with a shower possible after 1, then a better chance after dark; high near 61.
Likely the warmest day of the week, partly sunny with a high near 65 after a stray early shower, and more showers after midnight.
Showers possible by day with a high near 64, then rain turns likely Thursday night, so keep the umbrella handy.
Trending wetter and cooler Friday, showers likely with a high near 58, and a chance they linger into the night.
